data.headline: Full-stack development for real-time energy dashboards
data.summary: They build full-stack dashboards for grid operators using TypeScript, React, Java and Spring Boot. They also troubleshoot data imports, test software, review code and work with operators on screen usability.

signals.rendering: They build full-stack web applications with TypeScript and React on the front end and Java with Spring Boot on the back end.
They use TypeScript and React to build front-end interfaces.
They use Java with Spring Boot for back-end development.
They added logging, found a supplier's changed CSV date format and wrote a parser supporting both formats.
They set up a Grafana alert to flag recurring meter data import failures.
They observe grid operators using the screens every two weeks and work with a UX designer.
They review code for two junior developers on the team.
They use PostgreSQL and Docker in their development work.
They deploy applications to Azure using GitHub Actions.
They use tests on the import service, which has about eighty percent coverage.
They build dashboards that grid operators use to monitor electricity consumption in real time.

roles: Full-stack development in energy or climate tech
